notices.title: URGENT: Fall Semester Midterm Exam Schedule Released
notices.details: The official midterm examination timetable for all undergraduate programs has been published. Midterms commence on Monday, Oct 12, 2026. Hall tickets will be downloadable from student portal starting Oct 5.
notices.action: Download Exam Admit Card from student portal.

notices.title: Annual 36-Hour Hackathon 'HackSphere 2026' Registrations Open
notices.details: Registration is open for HackSphere 2026, the flagship national hackathon taking place Oct 24-25 in the Main Auditorium. Cash prizes pool worth $15,000 across Voice AI, Web3, and GreenTech tracks.
notices.action: Register teams of up to 4 members before Oct 15 at hacksphere.nexus.edu

notices.title: Extended Central Library Hours During Exam Period
notices.details: To support students preparing for upcoming examinations, the Central Library and 3rd Floor Quiet Study Lounges will operate 24/7 from October 8 through October 23. Free coffee will be served at midnight in the mezzanine.
notices.action: Access requires active Student ID tap at security gate after 10:00 PM.

notices.title: Scheduled Campus Wi-Fi & Network Maintenance
notices.details: IT Infrastructure is upgrading core access points to Wi-Fi 7 on Saturday, Oct 3 between 11:00 PM and 03:00 AM. Campus-wide Wi-Fi ('Nexus-Student') and Moodle may experience intermittent downtime.
notices.action: Save online submissions prior to 11:00 PM Saturday.

notices.title: Fall Semester Tuition Balance & Fee Payment Deadline
notices.details: The final date for clearance of 2nd installment semester dues without late penalty is October 25, 2026. Payments can be submitted via NetBanking, UPI, or Finance Office Counter 3.
notices.action: Pay dues via accounts portal to prevent semester registration holds.
